:::{#exm-mutual-information-bars}
#### Entropies of a noisy copy as bars

Take the fair coin $X$ and its noisy copy $Y$
from @exm-entropy-chain-rule-noisy-copy.
@fig-mutual-information-bars draws each [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) as a bar
whose length is its value in [bits](#def-bit),
adapting the bar diagram of the same entropies
in MacKay's book [@mackay2003information, Figure 8.1].
The bar for $\entropyf{X}$ starts at the left end of the bar for the [joint entropy](#def-joint-entropy) $\entropyf{X, Y}$,
and the bar for $\entropyf{Y}$ ends at its right end.
The two bars overlap by the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) $\mutinfof{X}{Y}$,
and the parts outside the overlap are the [conditional entropies](#def-conditional-entropy)
$\entropyf{X \mid Y}$ and $\entropyf{Y \mid X}$.

```{r}
#| label: fig-mutual-information-bars
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   The entropies of a fair coin $X$ and its noisy copy $Y$,
#|   in bits, as bars.
#|   The bottom row splits the joint entropy
#|   into the two conditional entropies and the mutual information.
#|   Adapted from the bar diagram of [@mackay2003information, Figure 8.1].
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Four rows of horizontal bars on a common axis in bits.
#|   The top bar, the joint entropy of X and Y, runs from 0 to about 1.72.
#|   The second, the entropy of X, runs from 0 to 1.
#|   The third, the entropy of Y, runs from about 0.72 to 1.72.
#|   The bottom row splits the top bar into three pieces:
#|   the conditional entropy of X given Y from 0 to about 0.72,
#|   the mutual information from about 0.72 to 1,
#|   and the conditional entropy of Y given X from 1 to about 1.72.
#| dev: !expr if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "cairo_pdf" else "svg"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3
#| code-fold: true
entropy_bits <- function(p) -sum(p * log2(p))
joint_copy <- matrix(data = c(0.4, 0.1, 0.1, 0.4), nrow = 2)
h_xy_bars <- entropy_bits(joint_copy)
h_x_bars <- entropy_bits(rowSums(joint_copy))
h_y_bars <- entropy_bits(colSums(joint_copy))
h_x_given_y_bars <- h_xy_bars - h_y_bars
bars <- data.frame(
  label = c(
    "ℍ(X, Y)", "ℍ(X)", "ℍ(Y)",
    "ℍ(X | Y)", "\U1D540(X ; Y)", "ℍ(Y | X)"
  ),
  left = c(0, 0, h_xy_bars - h_y_bars, 0, h_x_given_y_bars, h_x_bars),
  right = c(
    h_xy_bars, h_x_bars, h_xy_bars,
    h_x_given_y_bars, h_x_bars, h_xy_bars
  ),
  row = c(4, 3, 2, 1, 1, 1)
)
old_par <- par(mar = c(4, 1, 1, 1), family = "DejaVu Sans")
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, h_xy_bars), ylim = c(0.5, 4.5))
rect(
  xleft = bars$left,
  ybottom = bars$row - 0.35,
  xright = bars$right,
  ytop = bars$row + 0.35,
  col = "grey95",
  border = "black"
)
text(
  x = (bars$left + bars$right) / 2,
  y = bars$row,
  labels = bars$label
)
axis(side = 1)
title(xlab = "bits")
par(old_par)
```

In bits, the bars for $\entropyf{X}$ and $\entropyf{Y}$ each have length $`r round(h_x_bars, 3)`$,
and the bar for $\entropyf{X, Y}$ has length $`r round(h_xy_bars, 3)`$.
Their overlap, $\mutinfof{X}{Y} = `r round(h_x_bars + h_y_bars - h_xy_bars, 3)`$,
matches @exm-mutual-information-identities-noisy-copy.

:::
